best_idea: Run NPC dialogue as a server-side graph of screens whose text is chosen from the same quest state the talk changes, with a range leash that ends the talk when the player walks away.
decision_why: Take the data-driven screen graph, per-talk session with a range leash, and state-gated lines; add a hop limit to the handler chain, use one fixed line per state instead of random lines, and decide the lost-item rule before building.
acceptance: Talking to the pickup NPC once gives one item and sets picked up; a second talk says already picked up; a destination talk without the item says give-item and leaves the state; with the item it delivers, removes the item and sets delivered; walking 8 units away ends the talk.
